title: Collecting prepaid market orders
titleZh: 領取市集已付款的預訂品
passage: If you ordered anything from the Saturday market, please listen before you join the line. Because of the rain, all prepaid orders will be at the covered pickup counter beside the main gate. Stall numbers in your order message are still useful; read yours to the volunteer there so she can find the right bag. You don’t need to queue at the individual stalls. If you want to buy something you hadn’t ordered, use the stalls as usual. The counter can check a missing order, but it cannot accept payments for new purchases.
passageZh: 如果你在週六市集有預訂，排隊前請先聽一下。因為下雨，所有已付款的預訂品都會移到主入口旁、有遮蔽的取貨櫃檯。訂單訊息裡的攤位號碼仍有用，請念給那裡的志工聽，方便她找對袋子。不必在個別攤位排隊。若想買沒預訂的東西，還是照常到各攤位購買。取貨櫃檯可以查找不到的訂單，但不收新購品的款項。
audioScript: If you ordered anything from the Saturday market, please listen before you join the line. Because of the rain, all prepaid orders will be at the covered pickup counter beside the main gate. Stall numbers in your order message are still useful; read yours to the volunteer there so she can find the right bag. You don’t need to queue at the individual stalls. If you want to buy something you hadn’t ordered, use the stalls as usual. The counter can check a missing order, but it cannot accept payments for new purchases.
